source_and_authority_boundaries.invariant_vs_charge: Zero charge is a necessary route check here, not a sufficient invariant proof. Actual exterior degree, order/sign, dual covariance and determinant-one top-form extraction are checked separately.

general_covariance.premise: U is an invertible block action on the color-first C3 direct-sum W2 carrier, with det U=1; for the Hermitian-dual identification used by the course, U is unitary.
general_covariance.evaluation: For each vector v, (ell U^-1)(Uv)=ell v.
general_covariance.contraction: In the alternating deleted-slot definition, each contracted evaluation is unchanged and every remaining vector receives U. Therefore i_(ell U^-1)(Lambda^k U a)=Lambda^(k-1) U(i_ell a).
general_covariance.top_form: Wedge products transform under the induced exterior action. The final degree-(3,2) top form gains det U=1, so its coefficient relative to the fixed Omega is unchanged.
general_covariance.boundary: This algebraic argument, not charge cancellation or a few diagonal examples alone, supports general covariance on the stated action domain. The exact numerical tests separately cover three specified matrices, including a non-diagonal block rotation.

source_and_authority_boundaries.data_status: All numerical mass/matrix/energy inputs in this course are synthetic. Suggested observations remain proposed constraints; no measurements, rates or physical parameter uniqueness are inferred.
source_and_authority_boundaries.dimensional_scope: q, Y_h, electric charge, and Y_Yuk remain distinct; action is energy*time, mass is mu, squared mass mu^2, energy epsilon. Phase is not force and photon-equivalent model energy is not measured transfer.
source_and_authority_boundaries.residual_scope: Every ledger endpoint, component sign, prediction and signed remainder is retained. Model residual and separately supplied-transfer balance remainder are distinct channels, not discarded error.
